docs.desc: What we do with information, who controls it, and how to exercise your rights.

keyPoints.x: Noxtill LLC, an Arizona limited liability company
4539 N 22nd St Ste R, Phoenix, AZ 85016, United States

blocks.x: This policy explains what we do with information. Before the detail, here is the short version, and we hold ourselves to it:

rows: We do not sell personal information, and we have not sold personal information in the preceding twelve months, as "sell" is defined under United States state privacy law.
Share it for cross-context behavioral advertising
We do not share personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising, as "share" is defined under the California Consumer Privacy Act.
Market our product to your customers
Your customer list is yours. We do not contact the people in it to sell Noxtill.
Use your business data to train public AI models
Where AI features process your data, that processing serves your account only.
Read your data out of curiosity
Staff access is limited to support you asked for, a security investigation, or a legal obligation — and every access is logged.

sections.title: Two different relationships — read this first

blocks.x: Noxtill sits between two groups of people, and the law treats them differently. Which part of this policy applies to you depends on which group you are in.
2.1 If you are a business owner or staff member using Noxtill

We are the controller (under United States state law, the business) of information about you — your name, email, role, billing details, how you use the Service. Sections 3 and 5 to 11 describe what we do with it.
2.2 If you are a customer of a business that uses Noxtill

If you booked an appointment, bought something or sent a message to a business that runs on Noxtill, that business controls your information, not us. We are their processor (under United States state law, their service provider). We hold the information on their behalf and act on their instructions.

To see, correct or delete your information, contact the business you dealt with. If you contact us instead, we will forward your request to them and tell you we have done so. We cannot act on it ourselves, because the information is not ours to change.
2.3 If you visit our website
We are the controller of information collected on https://noxtill.com. See section 13 on cookies.
2.4 Why this matters

It decides who you ask, and who is accountable. A salon that uses Noxtill decides what to record about its clients, how long to keep it and who to send messages to. We supply the software and follow that salon's instructions.
3.1 Information you provide

rows: Name, business name, email, phone, postal address, account ID
To create and administer your account.
Plan, order history, payment method token, invoices, usage quantities
To bill you and provide the Service.
Role, business category, number of locations, team size
To configure your workspace and support you.

To answer you and improve the Service.

To meet legal and payment-provider obligations.

docs.title: Law Enforcement Request Guidelines
docs.desc: How we handle government and legal requests for customer data.

keyPoints.x: Noxtill LLC, an Arizona limited liability company
4539 N 22nd St Ste R, Phoenix, AZ 85016, United States

blocks.x: Businesses store their operating record with us. Some of it concerns their customers, who never chose us and may not know we exist. We treat a request for that data seriously, and we do not treat compliance as automatic.
1. We require valid legal process. A letter, an email, or a telephone call from an officer is not sufficient.
2. We assess every request. We check jurisdiction, scope, service and whether the process type matches the data sought.
3. We disclose the minimum. If process compels three fields, we produce three fields, not an account export.
4. We challenge overbroad requests. Including by narrowing scope before production and by moving to quash where appropriate.
5. We notify the affected customer, unless we are legally prohibited from doing so.
6. We do not provide direct or bulk access. No standing portal, no API, no automated feed.

faqs.q: How long is the free trial?
faqs.a: Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. You do not need a payment card to start an ordinary trial.

faqs.q: What is limited during the trial?
faqs.a: Trials include a set allowance, such as 200 AI credits. Paid calling, paid SMS and marketing campaigns unlock only after you add a payment method.

faqs.q: What happens when my trial ends?
faqs.a: You get a 72-hour grace period to activate a paid plan. During grace you can sign in and activate, but paid or metered activity stays off.

faqs.q: What happens if I do not activate?
faqs.a: After the 72-hour grace period the workspace is suspended. Billable automations stop, but owners keep access to billing and export.

faqs.q: How long can I export my data after suspension?
faqs.a: You have 30 days after suspension to recover or export supported workspace data. After that, data becomes eligible for deletion under our retention rules.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade or change plans?
faqs.a: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at your next renewal.

faqs.q: How do I cancel?
faqs.a: Account owners can cancel from billing settings at any time. Cancellation stops future renewals; access continues until the end of the paid period.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund?
faqs.a: Yes. Your first subscription payment is covered by a 30-day money-back guarantee: email support@noxtill.com within 30 days and we refund it in full. You do not need to give a reason. It applies once per customer.

faqs.q: Do my legal rights still apply?
faqs.a: Yes. The Refund Policy sits alongside your legal rights and does not replace them. Charges after cancelling, billing errors and duplicate payments are refunded in full, and where your local law is more generous, that law applies.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Payments are processed by Stripe. Cards are supported, and Apple Pay or Google Pay may be available depending on your country, browser and device.

faqs.q: What happens if a payment fails?
faqs.a: A failed renewal is handled separately from trial expiry. We notify the account owner and retry before restricting paid features.

faqs.q: What is an AI credit?
faqs.a: One standard AI action, such as a reply draft or summary. Larger tasks use more credits, and you see how many before you run them.

faqs.q: How do I request access to or deletion of my data?
faqs.a: Use the Privacy Choices Center to submit a verified request. If a Noxtill business holds your data, we route the request to that business.

faqs.q: How do I change cookie settings?
faqs.a: Open Cookie Settings and switch preference or analytics cookies on or off. Strictly necessary cookies cannot be switched off, and we do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies at all.

faqs.q: Is AI-generated content always correct?
faqs.a: No. AI output can be wrong or incomplete. Important actions wait for a person to approve them, on every plan.

faqs.q: Are calls recorded?
faqs.a: Only where the business has enabled recording, given the required notice and collected consent where the law requires it.

faqs.q: Can businesses send me WhatsApp or SMS messages?
faqs.a: Only with the consent the law requires for that channel and message type. Every marketing message must offer a way to opt out.

faqs.q: Can I connect my own tools through the API?
faqs.a: Yes. API and integration use is covered by the API & Integration Terms, including rate limits and security responsibilities.

faqs.q: How do I report a security vulnerability?
faqs.a: Follow the Vulnerability Disclosure Policy and email security@noxtill.com with details. Good-faith research within the policy is covered by our safe harbour. Please do not access other customers’ data.

faqs.q: Who are Noxtill’s subprocessors?
faqs.a: The verified register is published on the Subprocessor page. Account owners can subscribe to change notices.

faqs.q: Can I use Noxtill outside the United States?
faqs.a: Yes. The global baseline applies everywhere, with regional notices where we have reviewed local law. Check local requirements for your own use.
